DaVinci's going to draw flowers on the beach, Michelangelo's going to sit with his fear, you're going to log everything in a notebook. That's just who you all are. records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?

None. That's the point.

He wasn't doing it for a practical purpose, he was doing it because it kept him human. Kept all of us human honestly. You can't run on pure survival logic for five days without losing something.

The flowers stayed.
